setting.termsAndPrivacyDesc: Please read the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. They explain how we use your information and what you can do. By using the app, you agree to these terms.

terms-content.intro_content: Welcome to Scoreboard, a sports mini app providing live scores, news, a token mining feature and etc.. By using the Scoreboard app on Telegram, you agree to these Terms of Service. Please review these terms carefully as they govern your use of the app.
terms-content.elegibility_content: To use Scoreboard, you must be at least 13 years old or meet your country's age requirement. By using this app, you confirm that you meet this requirement.
terms-content.use_responsibilities_content_1: Account Information: You are responsible for keeping your Telegram account secure. Do not share your account details with anyone else.
terms-content.use_responsibilities_content_2: Mining Feature: The mining feature operates for a maximum of 4 hours per activation. Users must manually re-activate mining to continue earning. You agree to use this feature as intended.
terms-content.use_responsibilities_content_3: Acceptable Use: You agree not to misuse the app for illegal purposes, abuse other users, or disrupt the app's services.
terms-content.availability_content: Scoreboard may change or discontinue parts of the service at any time without notice. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service.
terms-content.property_content: The app's content, including the user interface, APIs, and design, is the property of Scoreboard or its licensors. You may not copy, distribute, or reverse-engineer any part of the app without permission.
terms-content.third_party_content: Scoreboard integrates with free sports APIs to provide live scores and news. We are not responsible for any third-party services or links accessed through the app.
terms-content.termination_content: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your access to Scoreboard at any time, especially for misuse of the app or violation of these terms. Upon termination, all mining progress, account data, and referrals will be lost.
terms-content.liability_content: Scoreboard is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages that may occur from using the app, including but not limited to data loss or service interruptions.
terms-content.governing_content: These terms are not governed by the laws of any specific country. Any disputes related to the use of Scoreboard will be resolved through direct communication and mutual agreement between the user and the Scoreboard team.
terms-content.change_to_terms_content: We may update these terms at any time. Any significant changes will be communicated via the Telegram app or email. Your continued use of the app after updates implies agreement to the revised terms.

privacy_content.intro_content: Your privacy is important to us at Scoreboard. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your data when using our app through Telegram.
privacy_content.info_collection_content_1: Personal Information: We collect the following personal data related to the mining feature: name, username, Telegram ID, referral information, and score details.
privacy_content.info_collection_content_2: Mining Data: The app also records your mining activity, including mining speed, boosters used, and streak updates.
privacy_content.info_collection_content_3: Telegram Data: We may or may not collect data from the Telegram API, such as your Telegram username and ID, to enhance and personalize your experience.
privacy_content.info_usage_content_1: We use the collected data to:
privacy_content.info_usage_content_2: Track mining activity and reward scores based on your participation.
privacy_content.info_usage_content_3: Personalize your experience by showing live scores and news based on your preferences.
privacy_content.info_usage_content_4: Monitor app performance and identify areas for improvement.
privacy_content.data_sharing_content_1: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with third parties only in the following cases:
privacy_content.data_sharing_content_2: With third-party services providing sports data (e.g., APIs), though this does not include your personal information.
privacy_content.data_sharing_content_3: If required by law or court orders.
privacy_content.data_storage_content: We store your data securely and take appropriate measures to protect it. However, no system is entirely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of your data. Data related to mining activities will be retained until you delete your account or request removal.
privacy_content.user_rights_content_2: Access the data we collect about you.
privacy_content.user_rights_content_3: Request correction or deletion of your personal information.
privacy_content.user_rights_content_4: Revoke consent for data processing by contacting our support team at
privacy_content.cookies_content: We only use cookies to personalize your experience by storing your language preferences (lang cookie). Third-party services providing live scores and news may use their own cookies independently to enhance their services.
privacy_content.children_content: Scoreboard is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from users below this age. If you are a parent and believe your child is using the app without consent, please contact us.
privacy_content.links_content: We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party services or websites linked within the app. Users should review the privacy policies of these services separately.
privacy_content.changes_content: We may update this Privacy Policy as the app evolves. Any changes will be communicated via the Telegram platform or email. Continued use of the app indicates your acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy_content.contact_info_content: For any questions or concerns regarding your privacy,please contact us at
